preconditions.description: The height and width of the grid must be between 2 and 1000.
The number of days must be between 1 and 10000.

preconditions.expression: all(len(row) == w for row in grid)
preconditions.description: Each row of the grid must have exactly w characters.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ki <= 10 for ki in days)
preconditions.description: The number of temporarily blocked cells for each day must be between 1 and 10.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ri <= h and 1 <= ci <= w for day in days for (ri, ci) in day)
preconditions.description: All temporarily blocked cells must be within the grid boundaries.

postconditions.description: The output for each day must be either 'YES' or 'NO'.
The number of output lines must equal the number of days processed.

postconditions.expression: all(stdout[i] == 'YES' if is_interesting(day) else stdout[i] == 'NO' for i, day in enumerate(days))
postconditions.description: Each output line must correctly reflect whether the day is interesting or not.
